# FrameAssembly (`frameassembly`)

> Deterministic network packet crafting Domain-Specific Language (DSL) and optimizing Rust compiler synthesizing nanosecond-accurate `.pcap` and `.pcapng` packet captures across 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols, dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 polymorphism, stateful 4-tuple TCP progression, and SNMPv3 USM (RFC 3414/3826/7860) cryptography.

FrameAssembly (`https://github.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly`, `https://crates.io/crates/frameassembly`) compiles human-readable, declarative `.fasm` specifications into bit-exact, reproducible `.pcap` / `.pcapng` captures with zero root privileges or live sockets required. Every protocol compiles with zero mandatory sub-keywords (RFC-compliant defaults) and supports fine-grained header and payload overrides.

## Canonical `.fasm` Grammar Rules (Anti-Hallucination Guardrails)

1. **Program Structure**: Every `.fasm` file declares one or more `HOST <id> { IP <ip> [MAC <mac>] }` blocks, one or more `FLOW <id>(<param1>, <param2>, ...) { <statements> }` blocks, and exactly one `COMPILE { <flow_calls_or_loops> }` block.
2. **Host Blocks**: Use space-separated `IP <ipv4_or_ipv6>` and optional `MAC <mac>` (`HOST client { IP 10.0.0.1 MAC 00:11:22:33:44:55 }`). Never use `=`, `:`, `,`, `IPV4`, `IPV6`, or `MASK`.
3. **Flow Blocks**: Always parameterize flows (`FLOW web(c, s) { c -> s HTTP GET URI "/" }`). Never use `FROM`, `TO`, `REVERSE`, `SEND`, standalone `WAIT` lines, or `+5ms` / `[+delay]` prefixes.
4. **Inline Timing**: Place `WAIT <int><ns|us|ms|s|m>` as an inline modifier on a frame statement (`c <- s HTTP STATUS 200 REASON "OK" WAIT 5ms`).
5. **L2–L4 Modifiers**: Use `VLAN <id> [PCP <p>] [DEI <d>]`, `QINQ <svlan> [INNER_VLAN <cvlan>]`, `MPLS <label> [EXP <e>] [BOS <b>] [MPLS_TTL <t>]`, `TTL <n>`, `DSCP <d>`, `ECN <e>`, `FLOWLABEL <fl>`, `IPID <id>`, `DF`, `MF`, `FRAGOFFSET <off>`, `SRCPORT <p>`, `DSTPORT <p>`, `SEQ <n>`, `ACKNUM <n>`, `WIN <w>`, and bare TCP flags (`SYN ACK FIN RST PSH URG ECE CWR`).
6. **Dataset Headers**: All `2,611` corpus `.fasm` files begin with `// PROMPT: <description>` on Line 1, `// TOKENS: <UPPERCASE_LEXER_TOKENS>` on Line 2, and `// INSTRUCTION: <explanation>` before every `HOST`, `FLOW`, and `COMPILE` block.

## Core Documentation (`docs/*.md`)

- [Architecture, Compiler Pipeline & Formal Grammar](docs/architecture_and_grammar.md): Five-stage compiler pipeline (`logos` -> `winnow` -> AST -> stateful backend -> `pcap-file`), `HOST`/`FLOW`/`COMPILE` syntax, L2–L4 modifiers, and dual-stack polymorphism.
- [Layer 2 Switching & Data-Link Protocols](docs/l2_protocols.md): Complete syntax and wire framing for `ARP`, `VLAN`, `QINQ`, `LLDP`, `STP`, `LACP`, `EAPOL`, and `MPLS` (248 verified examples).
- [Layer 3 Control, Tunneling, VPN & Routing Protocols](docs/l3_protocols.md): Complete syntax and wire framing for `ICMP`, `NDP`, `IGMP`, `MLD`, `GRE`, `VXLAN`, `GENEVE`, `IPSEC`, `ESP`, `AH`, `IKEV2`, `WIREGUARD`, `OSPF`, `BGP`, `RIP`, `VRRP`, `HSRP`, `PIM`, `BFD`, and `OPENFLOW` (620 verified examples).
- [Layer 4 Transport Protocols](docs/l4_transports.md): Stateful 4-tuple progression, bidirectional port inheritance, RFC 7323 TCP options, UDP checksums, and SCTP multi-chunk bundling for `TCP`, `UDP`, and `SCTP` (95 verified examples).
- [Layer 7 SNMPv1, SNMPv2c & SNMPv3 USM](docs/l7_snmp.md): ASN.1 BER encoding, `SNMP1`, `SNMP2`, and `SNMP3` USM authentication (`MD5`, `SHA`, `SHA256`, `SHA384`, `SHA512`), privacy encryption (`DES`, `AES`), and all 9 SMI `VARBIND` types (`93` verified examples).
- [Layer 7 Infrastructure, Time, AAA & Flow Telemetry](docs/l7_infra_and_telemetry.md): `DNS`, `MDNS`, `DHCP`, `NTP`, `PTP`, `RADIUS`, `TACACS`, `SYSLOG`, `NETFLOW`, `IPFIX`, and `SFLOW` (`341` verified examples).
- [Layer 7 Web, Cloud-Native, Transport Security, VoIP & Remote Access](docs/l7_web_and_cloud.md): `HTTP`, `HTTP2`, `GRPC`, `WEBSOCKET`, `TLS`, `QUIC`, `TFTP`, `FTP`, `SSH`, `TELNET`, `WHOIS`, `SIP`, `RTP`, `RTSP`, `STUN`, and `SSDP` (`496` verified examples).
- [Layer 7 Mail, Directory, Storage, Databases & Message Brokers](docs/l7_mail_auth_storage_db.md): `SMTP`, `IMAP`, `POP3`, `KERBEROS`, `LDAP`, `SMB`, `NFS`, `REDIS`, `MEMCACHED`, `MYSQL`, `POSTGRES`, `MQTT`, `COAP`, and `AMQP` (`434` verified examples).
- [Layer 7 Industrial Control Systems (ICS) & SCADA/OT](docs/l7_industrial_ot.md): `MODBUS`, `BACNET`, `DNP3`, `S7COMM`, `ETHERNETIP`, and `OPCUA` (`186` verified examples).
- [Multi-Protocol Topologies & Dual-Stack Architectures](docs/topologies_and_dual_stack.md): Leaf-Spine EVPN-VXLAN, Zero-Trust 802.1X NAC, 5G Service-Based Architecture, MPLS L3VPN, and Purdue ICS substations (104 verified topologies).
- [Instruction-Tuning Q&A Synthesis & Constrained Decoding Guide](docs/qa_synthesis_guide.md): Natural-Language Prompt to `.fasm` Q&A pairs and constrained decoding setup with `grammar.ebnf`, `frameassembly.gbnf`, and `frameassembly.lark`.

## Formal Grammars & Constrained Decoding Specifications

- [ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF Grammar](grammar.ebnf): Complete formal EBNF specification covering all 81 protocols and 640 uppercase terminal keywords.
- [llama.cpp & XGrammar GBNF Grammar](frameassembly.gbnf): Constrained decoding grammar for `llama.cpp` (`--grammar-file frameassembly.gbnf`), `vLLM`, `SGLang`, and `TensorRT-LLM`.
- [Lark / Outlines / llguidance CFG Grammar](frameassembly.lark): Earley/LALR Context-Free Grammar for `Outlines`, `Guidance`, and `llguidance`.
- [Full Single-Fetch LLM Context Bundle](llms-full.txt): Consolidated single-file bundle containing all 11 documentation guides, formal grammar, and representative `.fasm` corpus scenarios.

## Rust Compiler Architecture (`src/`)

- [Library Crate Root (`src/lib.rs`)](src/lib.rs): Public Rust API (`lexer::lex`, `parser::parse_program`, `parser::validate_semantics`, `backend::compile_program`, `backend::generate_pcap`).
- [CLI Entry Point (`src/main.rs`)](src/main.rs): `clap` command-line binary compiling `.fasm` files to `.pcap` / `.pcapng`.
- [Zero-Copy Lexer (`src/lexer/mod.rs`)](src/lexer/mod.rs): `logos 0.14` finite-automaton lexer defining all 640 uppercase keyword tokens, time units, IP/MAC/OID literals, and spans.
- [AST Definitions (`src/ast/mod.rs`)](src/ast/mod.rs): Strongly-typed AST nodes and `*Spec` structs across [`src/ast/l2/`](src/ast/l2/mod.rs), [`src/ast/l3/`](src/ast/l3/mod.rs), [`src/ast/l4/`](src/ast/l4/mod.rs), and [`src/ast/l7/`](src/ast/l7/mod.rs).
- [Two-Phase Combinator Parser (`src/parser/mod.rs`)](src/parser/mod.rs): `winnow 1.0` token-slice parser with protocol-scoped field dispatch ([`src/parser/fields.rs`](src/parser/fields.rs), [`src/parser/statement.rs`](src/parser/statement.rs)) and semantic validator ([`src/parser/validation.rs`](src/parser/validation.rs)).
- [Wire Payload Builders (`src/builders/mod.rs`)](src/builders/mod.rs): 81 native RFC wire encoders across [`src/builders/l2/`](src/builders/l2/mod.rs), [`src/builders/l3/`](src/builders/l3/mod.rs), [`src/builders/l4/`](src/builders/l4/mod.rs), and [`src/builders/l7/`](src/builders/l7/mod.rs) (including [`src/builders/l7/snmp/`](src/builders/l7/snmp/mod.rs)).
- [Stateful 4-Tuple Backend (`src/backend/mod.rs`)](src/backend/mod.rs): Flow expansion, `LOOP` unrolling, bidirectional port inheritance, TCP sequence/acknowledgment progression, and RFC 1112/2464 multicast MAC derivation.
- [Native Packet Framing (`src/packet.rs`)](src/packet.rs) & [PCAPNG Serializer (`src/pcap.rs`)](src/pcap.rs): Ethernet/VLAN/QinQ/MPLS/IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/SCTP header assembly, RFC 1071 & RFC 9260 CRC32c checksums, and nanosecond PCAPNG output.

## AI Agent & Metadata Files

- [Cross-Platform Bootstrap Installer (`install.sh`)](install.sh): One-line zero-clone installer (`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/main/install.sh | sh`) handling OS package manager prerequisites (`curl`, `ca-certificates`, C linker), `rustup` (`>= 1.85`), `cargo install frameassembly`, and automatic `.vsix` editor extension installation.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) & [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): AI coding agent onboarding, build commands, and canonical DSL invariants.
- [GitHub Copilot Instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md): IDE completion guardrails.
- [Context7 Configuration](context7.json), [CodeMeta JSON-LD](codemeta.json) & [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): Structured indexing and academic citation metadata.
